grid: 100 log-spaced points per decade from 10 to limit, including exact powers of ten
samples: 1000 log-uniform midpoint samples per decade [1,10),...; M is right-continuous; retain samples CSV
W: Exact step integral sum M(t)^2*(1/t-1/next_t), split at grid X; Kahan accumulation; floating point diagnostic not interval certificate
sign_changes: Ignore zero plateaus; count transitions between successive nonzero M values, assign transition to decade of new nonzero value; count all events, not only samples
variance: Population variance of M(x)/sqrt(x) on 1000 log midpoint samples per decade
generalised_integers: Free commutative prime-index monoid with multiplicities; equal numerical products aggregate N and mu contributions; repeated generator => mu=0
S3: Generate perturbed true primes far enough above X_max to include any q_p <= X_max; sort real generators; binary64 products; disclose boundary sensitivity
rho: Finite-range estimate rho_hat=N(X_max)/X_max; report N(x)-rho_hat*x and N(x)/x, plus adjacent-decade density drift. No claim of proven asymptotic rho or RH-quality from fit.

judges.J3: Small-X independent brute force multiplicity comparison; finite density stabilization report separately from enumeration correctness; convergence cannot be proved numerically

J4.plant: P(x)=0.05*(x^0.8*cos(7 log x)-1), P(1)=0; this is integral from 1 of derivative of 0.05*x^0.8*cos(7 log x)
J4.analytic: P^2/x^2 leading term =0.0025*x^-0.4*cos^2(7 log x). Integral leading =0.00125*x^0.6*[1/0.6+(0.6*cos(14log x)+14*sin(14log x))/(0.6^2+14^2)] plus constant/lower-order terms. Hence W ~ oscillatory positive factor * X^0.6/log X; envelope slope 0.6-1/log X (~0.513 to 0.538 on 1e5..1e7); bounded oscillatory modulation and baseline/cross terms remain.
J4.test: OLS slope log W_planted versus log X on [1e5,1e7] >=0.4; compute via analytic antiderivatives per integer interval or converged quadrature

prediction_operationalization.common: OLS log W vs log X on common [1e3,1e7]; finite-grid bounded := max W <= 1, not asymptotic boundedness; arithmetic mean across seeds, then grid points
prediction_operationalization.A1: HIT iff all S0 W in [0.01,1] on [1e3,1e8] and OLS slope <=0
prediction_operationalization.A2: HIT iff every S4 max W<=1 on [1e3,1e8] and mean S4 W < mean S0 W on identical grid
prediction_operationalization.A3: HIT iff every S1 max W<=1 on [1e3,1e7]
prediction_operationalization.A4: HIT iff mean S5 L/sqrt(x) on log samples [1e3,1e8] lies within 0.15 of 1/zeta(0.5), approximately -0.684765
prediction_operationalization.A5: HIT iff some non-S0 system/seed slope differs from S0 by >0.1 on common [1e3,1e7]

honesty: FINITE_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_RH; no paid calls; any truncation explicit; preregistration committed before production or pilot numerical runs
